title: MHS-STMA: Multimodal Hate Speech Detection via Scalable Transformer-Based Multilevel Attention Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a multimodal hate speech detection framework (MHS-STMA). While it addresses the identification of offensive content, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as defined in the instructions; it treats detection as a machine learning classification task.
